plan: Given my private value of $41, I should bid just below my value to maximize profit if I win. Rational bidders will bid close to their values, thus bidding slightly below $41, like $40.9, balances winning chances and profit. This strategy accounts for the possibility of other bidders having values close to mine and ensures I don't overpay compared to my valuation.

My value is $29, but rational bidders will not bid above their own value. To maximize profit, bid slightly below my value to ensure winning if others bid close to their values. A bid of $19.9 ensures winning unless others irrationally overbid their values. This balances winning likelihood and profit margin.

Given my value of $44, I aim to bid just below my value to maximize profit while outbidding others. A rational strategy is to bid slightly above the midpoint of the value range to outbid low bidders but stay below my value. Since the range is $0-$20, a bid around $15.1-$20 is optimal. This increases the chance of winning while keeping potential losses low if I overbid.
